learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the basic concepts, definitions, and history of korfball.
Students will learn basic knowledge, skills, and training methods specific to korfball.
Students will be able to transfer and apply the learned knowledge and skills.
Students will learn through interdisciplinary teaching and collaboration, and recognize fundamental principles and their application areas in sports.
Students will acquire the habit of playing team sports.

syllabus_topics: General information about the definition, history, and rules of korfball
Creating free space and collective play
Offensive and defensive systems in match application
